page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. The text runs down the page. Marginal quotation marks („) stand at the left edge of the lines and are part of the text, not notes. Digitiser's watermark at bottom right is excluded.

main_text.l: Angliæ de ann. 1647. sub Rege Carolo,
cap- 32. Id quod eleganter explicarunt impera-
tores Carol. & Ludovic. in Capitulari libr. 5.
c. 63. Illud ad exemplum reducendum est,
„nobis quoque judicandi. Et ideo nos à
„vobis recte judicamur. Et ex Prospero de „vita contempl. & actual. ipsis sacerdotibus
„proprie animarum curandarum sollicitudo „est commissa, qui pondus populi sibi com-
„plicant Deo: ac velut quidam Aaron, in-
„lo. Qui per Dei gratiam fiunt divinæ vo-
„circa sacra. Non illustre magis est, quam
illud Jacobi, regis Angliæ in controversiis
fidei satis versati qui ita scribit ad candidum
lectorem ante Apol. pro juramento fidelit. „Chri-

page.notes: Catchword "Chri-" is printed at the foot right, after the last line; it is part of the text as a hyphenated word and is not repeated as a catchword. Section marks and quotation marks at the line starts are printed marks. Some letters in the scan are faint (e.g. "fidelit.", "Constantinus") and are read as printed.
